privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: SOLIANCE attaches great importance to the protection of your personal data. This policy describes the data we collect when you use the Site or our services, why we process it, how long we keep it, who receives it, and the rights you have, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ("GDPR") and the amended French law no. 78-17 of 6 January 1978 ("Informatique et Libertés").

blocks.p: The data controller is SOLAR TRADE (trading name SOLIANCE), an SAS with a share capital of €10,000, RCS Antibes 949 576 946, 30 avenue du Général Leclerc, 06700 Saint-Laurent-du-Var. Data protection contact: adv@soliance-enr.fr — subject "Personal data".
We only collect the data needed for the purposes described below.

ul: Contact form and callback request: title, last name, first name, email address, phone number, postcode or town, subject of the request, message, preferred callback slot.

Solar simulator: address or town of the home, type of home, status (owner / tenant), surface area, roof orientation and pitch, electricity bill or consumption, related projects (battery, heat pump, charger), contact details for sending the results.

Referral programme: last name, first name, email address and phone of the referrer; last name, first name, phone and town of the referee. The referrer guarantees having informed the referee and obtained their agreement before sending us their details; the referee is told where their data came from at the first contact and may object to any processing.

Customer relationship (quote, contract, installation, after-sales): identity, contact details, data on the home and the installation, consumption and production data, billing and payment data, documents needed for administrative procedures (title deed, proofs, bank details, tax notice for subsidy files), exchanges with our teams.
Browsing data: IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, traffic source, cookie identifiers, under the conditions of the Cookie settings page.
Job applications: CV, cover letter, contact details, when a "careers" section is offered.

blocks.p: Fields marked as mandatory in the forms are needed to process your request; without them we cannot answer it.

blocks.p: We make no decision producing legal effects concerning you based solely on automated processing. The simulator's results are indicative estimates that do not bind SOLIANCE.

Your data is intended for the authorised teams of SOLIANCE (sales, sales administration, technical, after-sales) and of its sister company SOLIANCE CARE for the maintenance services you subscribe to. It may be shared, strictly as needed, with the following categories of recipients:

ul: Technical processors: the Site's host (OVH, France), the email service for our forms (Resend), our CRM provider (HubSpot), e-signature, messaging, accounting and installation monitoring tools.
Equipment manufacturers, to register warranties and activate monitoring apps.

Bodies whose involvement your project requires: town hall and planning authority, Consuel, grid operator (Enedis), electricity buyer (EDF OA), subsidy bodies (ANAH, CEE obligated parties, ADVENIR programme).
Financial partners and insurers, only at your request.
Partner installers working under SOLIANCE's responsibility.
Advisers, accountants, auditors, lawyers, and administrative or judicial authorities when the law requires it.

blocks.p: We neither sell nor rent your data to third parties.

Your data is hosted in France or in the European Union. Some of our providers (Resend, HubSpot, Google, Meta) are established in the United States or have servers there; the corresponding transfers are governed by the adequacy decision on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework when the provider is certified, and otherwise by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, supplemented by appropriate measures. You can obtain a copy of these safeguards by writing to us.

ul: Prospects (contact, simulator, referral not followed up): 3 years from your last contact, then deletion.

Customers: for the whole term of the contract and the warranties, then archived for the applicable limitation period (10 years from acceptance of the works for documents relating to the ten-year warranty; 10 years for accounting records).
Bank data: until full payment, then deletion (except mandatory accounting records).
Subsidy file data: the period required by the processing body.
Cookies and trackers: 13 months maximum; the choice made in the banner is kept for 6 months.
Unsuccessful job applications: 2 years after the last contact, unless you object.
Proof of identity sent to exercise a right: 1 year (3 years in case of objection).

blocks.p: SOLIANCE implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorised access: encrypted exchanges (HTTPS), strong authentication on our tools, access management, backups, choice of providers offering sufficient guarantees and bound by processing agreements compliant with article 28 GDPR. In the event of a data breach likely to result in a high risk to your rights, we will inform you under the conditions set by the regulations.

You have the following rights over your data: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, objection (including at any time and without reason to marketing), withdrawal of your consent at any time, and setting instructions on what happens to your data after your death.

To exercise these rights, write to us at adv@soliance-enr.fr or by post to SOLIANCE — Données personnelles, 30 avenue du Général Leclerc, 06700 Saint-Laurent-du-Var, stating the right you wish to exercise. A copy of an identity document may be requested if there is reasonable doubt about your identity. We will answer within one month, which may be extended by two months for complex requests.

You can also register on the opt-out list for telephone canvassing and, if you believe your rights are not respected, lodge a complaint with the Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL), 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07 — www.cnil.fr.
The Site and SOLIANCE's services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect data about minors.
This policy may be updated to reflect changes in our services or in the regulations. The version in force is the one published on the Site, with its update date.
